description: Daniel per-seat endorsement overrides. Always win over the automatic anti-split tree.
how_to_edit: Add an object to overrides[] with pcon24cd (ONS PCON24CD), endorse (reform|restore|none|other:<label>), optional note, by, at (ISO date).
Never set endorse to Labour or Conservatives — the engine rejects those.
Optional standing_intent: { reform?: yes|no|unknown, restore?: yes|no|unknown } for editor intent before Democracy Club confirmation (future use).
After editing, run: python3 scripts/build_endorsements.py (or scripts/refresh_voting_data.py).
